Ethylum Nitricum.



Nitric Ether. C 2  H 5  NO 3  (not to be confounded with nitrous ether, C 2  H 5  NO 2 , which is the principal ingredient in Sweet
        Spirit of Nitre).



Clinical. ─   Heart, hypertrophy of. Vertigo.



Characteristics. ─   This is one of the anæsthetics
        experimented on by J. Y. Simpson and later by B. W. Richardson. It has produced a few
        definite symptoms.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Glon., Amyl. nit.



SYMPTOMS.



2. Head. ─   A tendency to pitch forward.  ─  Sense
        of fulness in vessels of brain.  ─  Much headache and giddiness for some
        time after its employment.



6. Face. ─   Extreme suffusion of face.



19. Heart  . ─   Excessive
        over-action of the heart.  ─  Rapid and painful respiration.
